parameter: EIA 4.2 Marine: fish return system at the screens; intake velocity at most 0.15 m/s
remarks: ALP-EPC-00PAA-PR-STU-0001 (intake hydraulic model study); ALP-EPC-00PAA-ME-CAL-0001; ALP-EPC-00PAA-PR-SDS-0001; ALP-EPC-00UPA-CV-CVL-0001. Status preliminary.
value_text: The travelling band screens (equipment 00PAA10AT001 / 00PAA10AT002) are provided with a fish return trough and low-pressure screen wash; the intake structure is sized so that the through-screen velocity stays within the EIA value. The intake velocity limit is DP-EPCE-0011.
